        window.dataLayer.push({'environment': hostname[hostname.length - 3]});

    function doSZMRequest(options){
        
        
        if (typeof window.iom === 'undefined' || typeof iom.c === 'undefined') return;
        
        var iam_data = Antenne.iam_data;
        
        if (typeof options === 'object') {
            var iam_data = $.extend( {}, Antenne.iam_data, options );
        }
        
        
        
        if ((true === false && true === true) || 
        (Math.max(document.documentElement.clientWidth, window.innerWidth || 0) <= 600)) {
            if (iam_data.st === 'rockant' || iam_data.st === 'mobrocka') {
                iam_data.st = 'mobrocka';
            } else if (iam_data.st === '106acht' || iam_data.st === 'mobraham') {
                iam_data.st = 'mobraham';
            } else {
                iam_data.st = 'mobantba';
            }
            
            
            iam_data.sv = 'ke';
            
            
            iom.h(iam_data, 1);
            if (window.console) window.console.log('tracking iom.h as '+iam_data.st, iam_data);
        } else {
            iom.c(iam_data, 1);
            if (window.console) window.console.log('tracking iom.c as '+iam_data.st, iam_data);
        }
        
        return;
    }

<script data-usercentrics="Outbrain" type="text/plain">
if (window.console) console.log('Consent: Outbrain');
(function (window, document, undefined) {

    AntenneOutbrain = {
        outbrainPartnerKey: 'DEANT2ML37G4BMLJDB9MLE5JL',
        outbrainRequest: {
            permalink: 'https://www.antenne.de/',
            widgetId: 'APP_1',
            isSecured: 'true',
            testMode: false,
            installationKey: 'DEANT2ML37G4BMLJDB9MLE5JL'
        },

        init: function () {
            var self = this;
            loadJS('https://widgets.outbrain.com/outbrain.js', true, function () {
                OBR.extern.callRecs(self.outbrainRequest, self.initCallback);
            });
        },

        initCallback: function (json) {
            //var self = this; // self is no longer working
            if (window.console) console.log('OUTBRAIN data:', json);
            var wrapper = document.querySelector('.component--relatedarticles .teasers');
            
            if (wrapper === null) {
                // no related articles on this page
                return;
            }

            if (json.doc.length === 0) {
                if (window.console) console.log('OUTBRAIN no doc data');
                return;
            }
            
            var wrapper = document.querySelector('.component--relatedarticles .teasers');
            
            var header = document.querySelector('.component--relatedarticles .component__header small');
            header.innerHTML = '<div class="ob-api-what ob-one-line" data-language="de" data-partner="' + AntenneOutbrain.outbrainPartnerKey + '"></div>';
            loadJS('https://widgets.outbrain.com/external/whatIsForAPI/brandingForApi.js', true);

            // use IntersectionObserver to log event when recommendations are in viewport
            if ('IntersectionObserver' in window && typeof json.reportViewed === 'string') {
                var observerOptions = {
                    root: null, // relative to viewport
                    rootMargin: '10px', // margin around root
                    threshold: 1 // visible amount of item shown in relation to root
                };
                var observerCallback = function (changes, observer) {
                    changes.forEach(function (change) {
                        //if (window.console) console.warn('recommendations observer callback', change.target, change);
                        if (change.intersectionRatio > 0) {
                            //if (window.console) console.log('is in viewport!');
                            // call viewed for outbrain
                            OBR.extern.callViewed(json.reportViewed);
                            // unobserve, as we only need to log viewed once
                            observer.unobserve(wrapper);
                        }
                    });
                };
                var observer = new IntersectionObserver(observerCallback, observerOptions);
                observer.observe(wrapper);
            }

            for (var i = 0; i < json.doc.length; i++) {
                var doc = json.doc[i];
                var same_site = true;
                if (typeof doc.pc_id === 'number') {
                    same_site = false;
                } else if (doc.source_display_name.trim().toLowerCase() === 'antenne bayern') {
                    doc.source_display_name = 'ANTENNE BAYERN';
                }
                //console.log('Recommendation ' + i + ', Title:' + doc.content + ' -- URL: ' + doc.url);
                var content = `<article data-teaserid="${ 0-i }" class="teaser_item width-4 " itemprop="blogPost" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/BlogPosting">

    <div class="teaser_item__media">
        <noscript>
            <img itemprop="image" src="" width="502" height="250" alt="${ doc.content }" />
        </noscript>
        <!-- teaser-item images -->
        <img
            src="/assets/templates/img/placeholder.gif"
            data-src="${ doc.thumbnail.url }"
        
            class="lazyload"
            title="${ doc.content }">
    
    </div>
    <div class="teaser_item__content">
        <h3 class="teaser_item__title">
            
            <small class="teaser_item__category">${ same_site === true ? doc.source_display_name : 'Anzeige: ' + doc.source_display_name }</small><br>
            <a href="${ doc.url }" target="${ same_site === true ? "_self" : "_blank" }"  title="${ doc.content }" itemprop="url">
                <span itemprop="headline">${ doc.content } </span>
            </a>
        </h3>
    </div>
   
    <a class="faux-block-link-overlay" href="${ doc.url }" target="${ same_site === true ? "_self" : "_blank" }"  data-id="" title="${ doc.content }">
        ${ doc.content }
    </a>
</article>`;

                wrapper.innerHTML = content + wrapper.innerHTML;

                // remove last teaser
                var lastTeaser = document.querySelector('.component--relatedarticles .teasers [data-teaserid="' + (3 - i) + '"]');
                if (lastTeaser !== null) lastTeaser.parentNode.removeChild(lastTeaser);
            }
            
        }
    };
    
    // init
        AntenneOutbrain.init();
}(window, window.document));
</script>
